doc: metrics.patches on a float64 8x4 map whose values are not exactly representable in float32 (0.1, 1/3, ...): the function casts the map to float32 first (img.astype(np.float32)), so the samples are lerps of the float32-ROUNDED texels (a port that keeps float64 texels differs by up to 2.7e-8, ~30 times the tolerance). Output: the patches sampled at texels 0, 51, ..., 255 (params.stride_idx). Float64 geometry on float32 texels: 1e-9.
